assumptions: ASSUMPTION_TYPE_SYSTEM: Object types τ are formally defined with machine-checkable type signatures (not informal labels).
ASSUMPTION_MORPHISM_FAMILY_DECLARED: Morphism family Mτs,τt is explicitly registered with validator signature (not implicit).
ASSUMPTION_PRECONDITIONS_CHECKABLE: Preconditions P are machine-checkable predicates (not prose assumptions).
ASSUMPTION_INVARIANTS_DECLARED: Invariants I are explicitly declared before transfer (not post-hoc rationalization).
ASSUMPTION_FORBIDDEN_LOSSES_KNOWN: Forbidden losses L are explicitly enumerated and checkable (not unknown).
ASSUMPTION_BOUNDARIES_MEASURABLE: Boundaries B are measurable conditions (not vague limits).
ASSUMPTION_EVENIENCE_VERIFIABLE: Evidence E pointers are resolvable and verifiable (not missing links).
ASSUMPTION_COMPOSITION_TYPED: Composition m2∘m1 requires type matching at intermediate stages (not free-form chaining).
ASSUMPTION_OBLIGATION_TRANSPORT: Load-bearing obligations transport through composition (not silently dropped).
falsifier: Primary falsifier: untyped transfer witness (no declared morphism family, manual validation) achieves equal transfer success rate (LICENSED/(LICENSED+REJECTED)) at lower cost than typed registry. Secondary falsifiers: (1) Validator LICENSEDs type-mismatched witnesses (type checking failure); (2) Validator LICENSEDs witnesses with violated preconditions or lost invariants (obligation checking failure); (3) Composition of individually valid witnesses fails (intermediate type mismatch or obligation drop); (4) Validator LICENSEDs witnesses without sufficient evidence (CANNOT_CHECK should be returned).
hard_gate_obligations: OBLIGATION_TYPE_CHECKED: All witnesses must declare source and target object types matching a registered morphism family.
OBLIGATION_PRECONDITION_VERIFIED: All preconditions P must be machine-checked and satisfied before LICENSED.
OBLIGATION_INVARIANT_PRESERVED: All declared invariants I must be preserved under morphism (no silent drops).
OBLIGATION_FORBIDDEN_LOSS_ABSENT: No forbidden losses L occur under transformation (explicit check).
OBLIGATION_BOUNDARY_SATISFIED: All boundaries B must be satisfied at target (measurable condition).
OBLIGATION_EVENANCE_COMPLETE: Sufficient evidence E must exist and be verifiable before LICENSED.
OBLIGATION_COMPOSITION_TYPED: Composition m2∘m1 requires intermediate type matching.
OBLIGATION_OBLIGATION_TRANSPORT: Load-bearing obligations transport through composition chain.
OBLIGATION_VALIDATOR_MACHINE_CHECKABLE: All validator predicates must be executable code (not prose).
minimal_counterexamples: COUNTEREXAMPLE_UNTYPED_WITNESS_SUFFICES: Untyped transfer witness (no declared morphism family) achieves equal LICENSED rate at lower cost than typed registry.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_TYPE_MISMATCH: Validator LICENSEDs a witness where source/target types don't match declared morphism family (type checking failure).
COUNTEREXAMPLE_PRECONDITION_VIOLATED: Validator LICENSEDs a witness where preconditions P are violated (should be REJECTED).
COUNTEREXAMPLE_INVARIANT_LOST: Validator LICENSEDs a witness where declared invariants I are not preserved (should be REJECTED).
COUNTEREXAMPLE_FORBIDDEN_LOSS: Validator LICENSEDs a witness where forbidden losses L occur (should be REJECTED).
COUNTEREXAMPLE_BOUNDARY_CROSSED: Validator LICENSEDs a witness where boundaries B are violated (should be REJECTED).
COUNTEREXAMPLE_COMPOSITION_FAILS: Chained morphisms m2∘m1 pass individual validation but fail composition (intermediate type mismatch or obligation dropped).
COUNTEREXAMPLE_EVENANCE_MISSING: Validator LICENSEDs a witness without sufficient evidence E (should be CANNOT_CHECK).
COUNTEREXAMPLE_VALIDATOR_UNCHECKABLE: Validator predicates are not machine-checkable (prose instead of code).
novelty_residual: Novelty claimed only for: (1) Unified typed morphism registry that spans multiple object families (causal abstraction, assume-guarantee, homomorphism, proof translation) under a single validator interface; (2) Machine-checkable validator protocol with explicit preconditions, invariants, forbidden losses, boundaries, and evidence fields (stronger than ad-hoc transfer validation); (3) Composition legality enforcement with intermediate type matching and obligation transport (not present in existing structural_transfer). Delta over parents: structural_transfer is limited to relational transfer only; assume-guarantee logic lacks unified registry interface; homomorphism theory lacks implementation-level validation. Permitted publication claim must be scoped to these residuals after strongest-parent differential is measured.
object_description: Typed Morphism Registry (TMR): a generic transfer witness must name a morphism family. For object types τs, τt, register Mτs,τt and validator Vτ: Wτ → {LICENSED, REJECTED, CANNOT_CHECK} × Cert. A witness w = (τs, τt, m, q, P, I, L, B, E) specifies morphism m, QoI q, preconditions P, preserved invariants I, forbidden losses L, boundaries B, and evidence E. Candidate families: (1) causal exact/uniform abstraction (source-relations → target-relations with exact mapping), (2) assume-guarantee/refinement maps (precondition/postcondition preservation), (3) algebraic/order homomorphisms (structure-preserving maps with homomorphism property), (4) proof translations (deductive system mappings). Composition m2∘m1 is legal only if types match and every load-bearing obligation transports. Validators must be machine-checkable (type signatures, invariant predicates, boundary conditions). Output: Licensed/Rejected/CANNOT_CHECK with certificate, not self-promoting authority.
oracle_or_lower_bound: Lower bound: untyped transfer witness (no declared morphism family) with manual validation achieves same transfer success at lower cost. Oracle: optimal morphism family assignment that maximizes LICENSED rate while preserving all obligations (known only when full structure is observable).
permitted_publication_claim: PERMITTED_CLAIM_SCOPE: M3_TMR_v0 achieves higher transfer success rate (LICENSED/(LICENSED+REJECTED)) than untyped registry at equal cost when validators enforce machine-checkable preconditions, invariants, and boundaries across multiple object families. NO authority claimed for: (1) object families outside declared scope; (2) validators with uncheckable prose predicates; (3) transfers without declared morphism family; (4) settings where composition legality is not enforced. Claim scope is limited to typed morphism registry with machine-checkable validators and composition legality.
qoi: Typed morphism transfer quality measured by: (1) Type consistency: source and target object types match declared morphism family; (2) Precondition satisfaction: all preconditions P hold for source objects; (3) Invariant preservation: all declared invariants I are preserved under morphism m; (4) Forbidden loss absence: no forbidden losses L occur under transformation; (5) Boundary compliance: all boundaries B are satisfied at target; (6) Evidence completeness: sufficient evidence E exists to support the claim; (7) Composition legality: when chaining morphisms, intermediate types match and obligations transport.
same_system_ablation: Ablations required on same input data: (1) UNTYPED_REGISTRY: no declared morphism families, manual validation only; (2) NO_VALIDATOR: registry without machine-checkable validators; (3) NO_PRECONDITION_CHECK: validator skips precondition verification; (4) NO_INVARIANT_CHECK: validator skips invariant preservation; (5) NO_COMPOSITION_CHECK: validator skips intermediate type matching. Each ablation must run on identical development and fresh case sets to isolate specific mechanistic contributions.

strongest_parents.cost_equation: cost = relation_preservation_checks × relation_cost + invariant_checks × invariant_cost + boundary_validations × boundary_cost
strongest_parents.justification: Existing RAKL structural transfer provides typed witness validation, role mapping, relation preservation, invariant checking, and boundary validation. Strongest in-repo parent for transfer witnesses.
Assume-guarantee logic and refinement calculus provide formal frameworks for precondition/postcondition preservation under transformation. Strongest parent for obligation-preserving maps.
Algebraic homomorphisms provide structure-preserving maps with operation preservation. Strongest parent for algebraic transfer witnesses.

total_cost_equation: total_cost = registry_maintenance_cost + validator_development_cost + witness_validation_cost + composition_checking_cost + ablation_comparison_cost. Registry maintenance cost = sum over families of (type_definition_cost + validator_signature_cost). Validator development cost = sum over validators of (predicate_implementation_cost + test_cost). Witness validation cost = sum over witnesses of (type_check_cost + precondition_check_cost + invariant_check_cost + boundary_check_cost + evidence_verification_cost). Composition checking cost = sum over composition chains of (intermediate_type_check_cost + obligation_transport_check_cost). Ablation comparison cost = sum over ablations of same_system_run_cost.
